data.name: Sweeping Fend
data.description: At 13th level, a polearm master can use any spear or pole arm to make a bull rush or trip maneuver, though he takes a -4 penalty to his CMB when making such attempts. Weapons with the trip property do not incur this penalty on trip maneuvers. This ability replaces weapon training 3.
